name: Eric Chorley
text: Darren and Lewis installed a replacement boiler in my home yesterday. They arrived promptly and immediately started work. Once he had removed the casing, Darren explained to me why the old boiler had been playing up, showing me where a leak had caused the casing to rust. Before too much time the new smaller more efficient boiler was in place and the new pipework was taking shape. Getting the boiler in place is only part of the job, there are extensive tests that are required to properly set up the system for maximum efficiency. By about 4pm the system was up and running properly and the guys were on their way home, after another job well done and a very satisfied client.
